svg.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Amazon EKS workshop architecture: Karpenter, Kargo, Argo CD
svg.text: Amazon EKS Workshop: Karpenter + Kargo + Argo CD
Kiến trúc AWS tham chiếu: tự co giãn node (Karpenter) và promotion có kiểm soát (Kargo + Argo CD)
pull from Git, sync manifests to the cluster
A. Delivery flow (GitOps): Kargo + Argo CD
CI pushes a new image to Amazon ECR
Kargo Warehouse sees the new tag and creates Freight
Freight is promoted stage by stage: test > uat > prod
Kargo commits the change to Git (branch stage/<name>)
Argo CD pulls the desired state from Git
Kargo triggers an Argo CD sync of the Application
Argo CD applies manifests, pods roll out on EKS
Sees Pending pods, reads NodePool + EC2NodeClass
New EC2 nodes join the cluster (private subnets)
EventBridge sends Spot interruption events to SQS
Karpenter polls SQS, drains and replaces the node
IAM (red dashed): Karpenter controller uses EKS Pod Identity;
nodes use the node IAM role via instance profile.
User resolves the domain in Route 53 (optional)
HTTPS reaches the ALB in public subnets via the IGW
ALB forwards to app pod IPs in private subnets
AWS LB Controller reconciles Ingress to ALB (dashed)
Grey dashed: private nodes reach ECR / Git / AWS APIs
through NAT Gateway > IGW (or VPC endpoints).
